basic_info.description: Enjoy the sunny views from this penthouse condo in trendy Hayes Valley! This 2 bedroom and 2 bathroom home features impressive South and West-facing floor-to-ceiling windows, incredible views, a chef's kitchen equipped with Bosch appliances, sleek cabinets, wood floors throughout and in-unit washer/dryer. A deeded on-site parking space with EV charger and walk-in storage are included. Designed by Ian Birchall & Associates, the building has a sunny rooftop terrace, dog park, front desk service, and private lounge. The location is prime. Your new home just steps away from SF Jazz and the Symphony, Muni and Bart lines, upscale boutiques for designer fashions, Ritual coffee shop, La Boulangerie, Salt & Straw, and many more restaurants and bars.
